```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fixest)
library(janitor)

winsorize <- function(x, p = 0.01) {
  lo <- quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE)
  hi <- quantile(x, 1 - p, na.rm = TRUE)
  pmax(pmin(x, hi), lo)
}
```

## Labor Productivity

```{r}
bls_raw <- read_excel(
  "../Data/Source data/major-industry-total-factor-productivity-klems.xlsx",
  sheet = "MachineReadable"
) %>%
  clean_names()

labor_productivity <- bls_raw %>%
  filter(
    basis   == "All workers",
    measure == "Labor productivity",
    units   == "Index (2017=100)",
    year    >= 1997,
    year    <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(bls_naics = naics, bls_industry = industry, year, lp_index = value) %>%
  mutate(
    year     = as.integer(year),
    lp_index = as.numeric(lp_index),
    ln_lp    = log(lp_index)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lp_index))

tfp_productivity <- bls_raw %>%
  filter(
    basis   == "All workers",
    measure == "Total factor productivity",
    units   == "Index (2017=100)",
    year    >= 1997,
    year    <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(bls_naics = naics, bls_industry = industry, year, tfp_index = value) %>%
  mutate(
    year      = as.integer(year),
    tfp_index = as.numeric(tfp_index),
    ln_tfp    = log(tfp_index)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tfp_index))

capital_contrib <- bls_raw %>%
  filter(
    measure == "Contribution of capital intensity to labor productivity",
    units   == "Index (2017=100)",
    year    >= 1997,
    year    <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(bls_naics = naics, bls_industry = industry, year,
         capital_contrib_lp = value) %>%
  mutate(
    year               = as.integer(year),
    capital_contrib_lp = as.numeric(capital_contrib_lp)
  )

ipp_contrib <- bls_raw %>%
  filter(
    measure == "Contribution of capital input excluding IPP and IPE intensity to labor productivity",
    units   == "Index (2017=100)",
    year    >= 1997,
    year    <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(bls_naics = naics, bls_industry = industry, year,
         non_ict_capital_contrib = value) %>%
  mutate(
    year                    = as.integer(year),
    non_ict_capital_contrib = as.numeric(non_ict_capital_contrib)
  )

eng_contrib <- bls_raw %>%
  filter(
    measure == "Contribution of energy intensity to labor productivity",
    units   == "Index (2017=100)",
    year    >= 1997,
    year    <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(bls_naics = naics, bls_industry = industry, year,
         eng_contrib = value) %>%
  mutate(
    year                    = as.integer(year),
    eng_contrib = as.numeric(eng_contrib)
  )

cat("Labor productivity rows:", nrow(labor_productivity), "\n")
cat("Industries:", n_distinct(labor_productivity$bls_naics), "\n")
cat("Years:", min(labor_productivity$year), "to", max(labor_productivity$year), "\n")
```


## Controls

```{r}

controls_raw <- read_excel(
  "../Data/Source data/Controls_Panel_1997_2022.xlsx",
  sheet = "Panel"
) %>%
  clean_names()

controls <- controls_raw %>%
  filter(year >= 1997, year <= 2022) %>%
  mutate(
    year              = as.integer(year),
    capital_intensity = as.numeric(capital_intensity),
    log_va_growth     = as.numeric(log_va_growth),
    college_share     = as.numeric(education_college_share)
  ) %>%
  select(
    ctrl_industry = industry,
    bea_code,
    ctrl_naics    = naics_code,
    year,
    capital_intensity,
    log_va_growth,
    college_share
  )

# ── Extend to 2024 with NA placeholders for 2023 and 2024 ────────────────────
controls_extended <- controls %>%
  distinct(ctrl_industry, bea_code, ctrl_naics) %>%
  crossing(year = c(2023L, 2024L)) %>%
  mutate(
    capital_intensity = NA_real_,
    log_va_growth     = NA_real_,
    college_share     = NA_real_
  )

controls <- bind_rows(controls, controls_extended) %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year)

cat("Controls rows after extension:", nrow(controls), "\n")
cat("Years now covered:", min(controls$year), "to", max(controls$year), "\n")
```

```{r}
  distinct(bls_naics) %>%
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "bls_naics") %>%
```

## Merge Labor Productivity + Controls

```{r}
panel_merged <- labor_productivity %>%
  inner_join(crosswalk, by = "bls_naics") %>%
  inner_join(tfp_productivity, by = c("bls_naics", "year")) %>%
  inner_join(controls, by = c("bea_code", "year")) %>%
  select(
    bea_code,
    industry = ctrl_industry,
    bls_naics,
    year,
    lp_index,
    tfp_index,
    ln_tfp,
    ln_lp,
    capital_intensity,
    log_va_growth,
    college_share
  )

cat("Rows:", nrow(panel_merged), "\n")
cat("Industries:", n_distinct(panel_merged$bea_code), "\n")
cat("Years:", min(panel_merged$year), "to", max(panel_merged$year), "\n")
```

## Add AIIE (Employment-Weighted, with 521-522 Fix)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

panel2<- read_csv("../Data/Intermediate data/panel_lpctrls2.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
head(panel2)
aiie_raw  <- read_csv("../Data/Intermediate data/genAIIE with empl panel for K.csv") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(naics = as.character(naics))

# ── Step 1: Map 6-digit NAICS to BEA codes ─────────────────────────────────
aiie <- aiie_raw %>%
  mutate(bea_code = case_when(
    naics %in% c("113300", "115100", "115200")           ~ "113FF",
    naics == "211100"                                    ~ "211",
    naics %in% c("212100", "212200", "212300")           ~ "212",
    naics == "213100"                                    ~ "213",
    str_starts(naics, "221")                             ~ "22",
    str_starts(naics, "236") | str_starts(naics, "237") |
      str_starts(naics, "238")                           ~ "23",
    str_starts(naics, "311") | str_starts(naics, "312") ~ "311FT",
    str_starts(naics, "313") | str_starts(naics, "314") ~ "313TT",
    str_starts(naics, "315") | str_starts(naics, "316") ~ "315AL",
    str_starts(naics, "321")                             ~ "321",
    str_starts(naics, "322")                             ~ "322",
    str_starts(naics, "323")                             ~ "323",
    str_starts(naics, "324")                             ~ "324",
    str_starts(naics, "325")                             ~ "325",
    str_starts(naics, "326")                             ~ "326",
    str_starts(naics, "327")                             ~ "327",
    str_starts(naics, "331")                             ~ "331",
    str_starts(naics, "332")                             ~ "332",
    str_starts(naics, "333")                             ~ "333",
    str_starts(naics, "334")                             ~ "334",
    str_starts(naics, "335")                             ~ "335",
    naics %in% c("336100", "336200", "336300")           ~ "3361MV",
    naics %in% c("336400", "336500", "336600", "336900") ~ "3364OT",
    str_starts(naics, "337")                             ~ "337",
    str_starts(naics, "339")                             ~ "339",
    str_starts(naics, "423") | str_starts(naics, "424") |
      str_starts(naics, "425") |
      naics %in% c("4230A1", "4240A1", "4240A2", "4240A3") ~ "42",
    str_starts(naics, "441") | str_starts(naics, "442") |
      str_starts(naics, "443") | str_starts(naics, "444") |
      str_starts(naics, "445") | naics == "4450A1"      |
      str_starts(naics, "446") | str_starts(naics, "447") |
      str_starts(naics, "448") | str_starts(naics, "451") |
      str_starts(naics, "452") | str_starts(naics, "453") |
      naics == "4530A1"         | str_starts(naics, "454") ~ "44RT",
    str_starts(naics, "481")                             ~ "481",
    str_starts(naics, "482")                             ~ "482",
    str_starts(naics, "483")                             ~ "483",
    str_starts(naics, "484")                             ~ "484",
    str_starts(naics, "485")                             ~ "485",
    str_starts(naics, "486")                             ~ "486",
    str_starts(naics, "487") | str_starts(naics, "488") |
      str_starts(naics, "492")                           ~ "487OS",
    str_starts(naics, "493")                             ~ "493",
    str_starts(naics, "511")                             ~ "511",
    str_starts(naics, "512")                             ~ "512",
    str_starts(naics, "515") | naics == "517000"         ~ "513",
    str_starts(naics, "518") | str_starts(naics, "519") ~ "514",
    # FIX 1: 521-522 added — was missing, caused 52CI to drop from AIIE merge
    str_starts(naics, "521") | str_starts(naics, "522") ~ "52CI",
    str_starts(naics, "523")                             ~ "523",
    str_starts(naics, "524")                             ~ "524",
    str_starts(naics, "525")                             ~ "525",
    str_starts(naics, "531")                             ~ "531",
    str_starts(naics, "532") | str_starts(naics, "533") |
      naics == "5320A1"                                  ~ "532RL",
    naics == "541100"                                    ~ "5411",
    naics == "541500"                                    ~ "5415",
    naics %in% c("541200", "541300", "541400",
                 "541600", "541700", "541800", "541900") ~ "5412OP",
    str_starts(naics, "551")                             ~ "55",
    str_starts(naics, "561")                             ~ "561",
    str_starts(naics, "562")                             ~ "562",
    str_starts(naics, "611")                             ~ "61",
    str_starts(naics, "621")                             ~ "621",
    str_starts(naics, "622") | str_starts(naics, "623") ~ "622HO",
    str_starts(naics, "624")                             ~ "624",
    str_starts(naics, "711") | str_starts(naics, "712") ~ "711AS",
    str_starts(naics, "713")                             ~ "713",
    str_starts(naics, "721")                             ~ "721",
    str_starts(naics, "722")                             ~ "722",
    str_starts(naics, "811") | str_starts(naics, "812") |
      str_starts(naics, "813")                           ~ "81",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))


cat("=== AIIE NAICS WITH NO BEA MATCH ===\n")
aiie %>%
  filter(is.na(bea_code)) %>%
  distinct(naics, naics_title) %>%
  arrange(naics) %>%
  print(n = 50)

cat("\n=== PANEL INDUSTRIES WITH NO AIIE MATCH ===\n")
panel2 %>%
  distinct(bea_code, industry) %>%
  anti_join(aiie %>% filter(!is.na(bea_code)) %>% distinct(bea_code),
            by = "bea_code") %>%
  print()

# ── Step 2: Aggregate AIIE to bea_code x year using employment weights ──────

aiie_weighted <- aiie %>%
  filter(!is.na(bea_code)) %>%
  group_by(bea_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # Employment-weighted average within each BEA group x year
    aggregate_raw_aiie_w = weighted.mean(aggregate_raw_aiie, w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    lm_raw_aiie_w        = weighted.mean(lm_raw_aiie,        w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    ig_raw_aiie_w        = weighted.mean(ig_raw_aiie,         w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    aggregate_aiie_w     = weighted.mean(aggregate_aiie,      w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    lm_aiie_w            = weighted.mean(lm_aiie,             w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    ig_aiie_w            = weighted.mean(ig_aiie,             w = employment,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    employment     = sum(employment,     na.rm = TRUE),
    log_employment = log(sum(employment, na.rm = TRUE)),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    employment     = na_if(employment,     0),
    log_employment = na_if(log_employment, -Inf)
  ) %>%
  arrange(bea_code, year) %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  mutate(
    employment_lag1     = lag(employment,     1),
    log_employment_lag1 = lag(log_employment, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
    


panel_merged2 <- aiie_weighted %>%
  right_join(panel2, by = c("bea_code", "year")) %>%
  select(all_of(names(panel2)),
         aggregate_raw_aiie_w, lm_raw_aiie_w, ig_raw_aiie_w,
         aggregate_aiie_w, lm_aiie_w, ig_aiie_w, employment, log_employment, employment_lag1, log_employment_lag1)

head(panel_merged2)

aiie2 <- aiie %>%
  filter(!is.na(bea_code)) %>%
  group_by(bea_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # Employment-weighted average within each BEA group x year
    aggregate_raw_aiie = mean(aggregate_raw_aiie, na.rm = TRUE),
    lm_raw_aiie        = mean(lm_raw_aiie,        na.rm = TRUE),
    ig_raw_aiie        = mean(ig_raw_aiie,         na.rm = TRUE),
    aggregate_aiie     = mean(aggregate_aiie,      na.rm = TRUE),
    lm_aiie            = mean(lm_aiie,             na.rm = TRUE),
    ig_aiie            = mean(ig_aiie,             na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

panel_merged3 <- aiie2 %>%
  right_join(panel_merged2, by = c("bea_code", "year")) %>%
  select(all_of(names(panel_merged2)),
         aggregate_raw_aiie, lm_raw_aiie, ig_raw_aiie,
         aggregate_aiie, lm_aiie, ig_aiie)

cat("\n=== MERGED PANEL (with AIIE) ===\n")
cat("Rows:        ", nrow(panel_merged3), "\n")
cat("Industries:  ", n_distinct(panel_merged3$bea_code), "\n")
cat("Years:       ", min(panel_merged3$year), "–", max(panel_merged3$year), "\n")
cat("Missing AIIE:", sum(is.na(panel_merged3$aggregate_aiie)), "\n")

head(panel_merged3)

write_csv(panel_merged3, "../Data/Intermediate data/panel_mergedtry1.csv")
cat("Saved → panel_mergedtry1.csv\n")
```

## Build WFH Industry Score (Dingel & Neiman)

```{r}
# Inputs 

wfh_occ <- read_csv(
  "../Data/Source data/occupations_workathome.csv"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(occ_code = str_sub(onetsoccode, 1, 7))

oes_2019 <- read_excel(
  "../Data/Source data/Employment source files/nat4d_M2019_dl.xlsx"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(area_type == 1, o_group == "detailed") %>%
  mutate(
    naics   = as.character(naics),
    tot_emp = as.numeric(tot_emp)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tot_emp), tot_emp > 0)

# ── Step 1: Build WFH lookup with three-tier fallback ───────────────────────
wfh_detailed <- wfh_occ %>%
  group_by(occ_code) %>%
  summarise(wfh = mean(teleworkable, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Broad fallback: use first 6 characters (XX-XXXX -> XX-XXX*)
wfh_broad <- wfh_occ %>%
  mutate(occ_broad = str_sub(occ_code, 1, 6)) %>%
  group_by(occ_broad) %>%
  summarise(wfh_broad = mean(teleworkable, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Major group fallback: use first 2 characters (XX-)
wfh_major <- wfh_occ %>%
  mutate(major_group = str_sub(occ_code, 1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(major_group) %>%
  summarise(wfh_major = mean(teleworkable, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ── Step 2: Merge WFH onto OES, applying fallbacks for unmatched occupations
oes_with_wfh <- oes_2019 %>%
  # Tier 1: exact 6-char SOC match
  left_join(wfh_detailed, by = "occ_code") %>%
  # Tier 2: broad group fallback (first 6 chars)
  mutate(occ_broad = str_sub(occ_code, 1, 6)) %>%
  left_join(wfh_broad, by = "occ_broad") %>%
  # Tier 3: major group fallback (first 2 chars)
  mutate(major_group = str_sub(occ_code, 1, 2)) %>%
  left_join(wfh_major, by = "major_group") %>%

  mutate(
    wfh_score = case_when(
      !is.na(wfh)       ~ wfh,        # exact match
      !is.na(wfh_broad) ~ wfh_broad,  # broad group
      !is.na(wfh_major) ~ wfh_major,  # major group
      TRUE              ~ NA_real_
    ),
    match_tier = case_when(
      !is.na(wfh)       ~ "exact",
      !is.na(wfh_broad) ~ "broad",
      !is.na(wfh_major) ~ "major",
      TRUE              ~ "unmatched"
    )
  )

cat("=== WFH MATCH QUALITY ===\n")
oes_with_wfh %>%
  group_by(match_tier) %>%
  summarise(
    n_occ_rows = n(),
    total_emp  = sum(tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(emp_share = round(total_emp / sum(total_emp) * 100, 1)) %>%
  print()

# ── Step 3: Map OES NAICS to BEA codes ──────────────────────────────────────
oes_with_wfh <- oes_with_wfh %>%
  mutate(bea_code = case_when(
    naics %in% c("113300", "115100", "115200")           ~ "113FF",
    naics == "211100"                                    ~ "211",
    naics %in% c("212100", "212200", "212300")           ~ "212",
    naics == "213100"                                    ~ "213",
    str_starts(naics, "221")                             ~ "22",
    str_starts(naics, "236") | str_starts(naics, "237") |
      str_starts(naics, "238")                           ~ "23",
    str_starts(naics, "311") | str_starts(naics, "312") ~ "311FT",
    str_starts(naics, "313") | str_starts(naics, "314") ~ "313TT",
    str_starts(naics, "315") | str_starts(naics, "316") ~ "315AL",
    str_starts(naics, "321")                             ~ "321",
    str_starts(naics, "322")                             ~ "322",
    str_starts(naics, "323")                             ~ "323",
    str_starts(naics, "324")                             ~ "324",
    str_starts(naics, "325")                             ~ "325",
    str_starts(naics, "326")                             ~ "326",
    str_starts(naics, "327")                             ~ "327",
    str_starts(naics, "331")                             ~ "331",
    str_starts(naics, "332")                             ~ "332",
    str_starts(naics, "333")                             ~ "333",
    str_starts(naics, "334")                             ~ "334",
    str_starts(naics, "335")                             ~ "335",
    naics %in% c("336100", "336200", "336300")           ~ "3361MV",
    naics %in% c("336400", "336500", "336600", "336900") ~ "3364OT",
    str_starts(naics, "337")                             ~ "337",
    str_starts(naics, "339")                             ~ "339",
    str_starts(naics, "423") | str_starts(naics, "424") |
      str_starts(naics, "425") |
      naics %in% c("4230A1", "4240A1", "4240A2", "4240A3") ~ "42",
    str_starts(naics, "441") | str_starts(naics, "442") |
      str_starts(naics, "443") | str_starts(naics, "444") |
      str_starts(naics, "445") | naics == "4450A1"      |
      str_starts(naics, "446") | str_starts(naics, "447") |
      str_starts(naics, "448") | str_starts(naics, "451") |
      str_starts(naics, "452") | str_starts(naics, "453") |
      naics == "4530A1"         | str_starts(naics, "454") ~ "44RT",
    str_starts(naics, "481")                             ~ "481",
    str_starts(naics, "482")                             ~ "482",
    str_starts(naics, "483")                             ~ "483",
    str_starts(naics, "484")                             ~ "484",
    str_starts(naics, "485")                             ~ "485",
    str_starts(naics, "486")                             ~ "486",
    str_starts(naics, "487") | str_starts(naics, "488") |
      str_starts(naics, "492")                           ~ "487OS",
    str_starts(naics, "493")                             ~ "493",
    str_starts(naics, "511")                             ~ "511",
    str_starts(naics, "512")                             ~ "512",
    str_starts(naics, "515") | naics == "517000"         ~ "513",
    str_starts(naics, "518") | str_starts(naics, "519") ~ "514",
    str_starts(naics, "521") | str_starts(naics, "522") ~ "52CI",
    str_starts(naics, "523")                             ~ "523",
    str_starts(naics, "524")                             ~ "524",
    str_starts(naics, "525")                             ~ "525",
    str_starts(naics, "531")                             ~ "531",
    str_starts(naics, "532") | str_starts(naics, "533") |
      naics == "5320A1"                                  ~ "532RL",
    naics == "541100"                                    ~ "5411",
    naics == "541500"                                    ~ "5415",
    naics %in% c("541200", "541300", "541400",
                 "541600", "541700", "541800", "541900") ~ "5412OP",
    str_starts(naics, "551")                             ~ "55",
    str_starts(naics, "561")                             ~ "561",
    str_starts(naics, "562")                             ~ "562",
    str_starts(naics, "611")                             ~ "61",
    str_starts(naics, "621")                             ~ "621",
    str_starts(naics, "622") | str_starts(naics, "623") ~ "622HO",
    str_starts(naics, "624")                             ~ "624",
    str_starts(naics, "711") | str_starts(naics, "712") ~ "711AS",
    str_starts(naics, "713")                             ~ "713",
    str_starts(naics, "721")                             ~ "721",
    str_starts(naics, "722")                             ~ "722",
    str_starts(naics, "811") | str_starts(naics, "812") |
      str_starts(naics, "813")                           ~ "81",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# ── Step 4: Aggregate to BEA industry level (employment-weighted) ────────────
wfh_industry <- oes_with_wfh %>%
  filter(!is.na(bea_code), !is.na(wfh_score)) %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  summarise(
    wfh_index     = weighted.mean(wfh_score, w = tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_occ         = n(),
    total_emp_oes = sum(tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== WFH INDEX BY INDUSTRY ===\n")
wfh_industry %>%
  arrange(desc(wfh_index)) %>%
  print(n = 60)

# Check which panel industries are missing a WFH score
cat("\n=== PANEL INDUSTRIES WITH NO WFH SCORE ===\n")
panel_merged3 %>%
  distinct(bea_code, industry) %>%
  anti_join(wfh_industry, by = "bea_code") %>%
  print()

# ── Step 5: Merge WFH index onto panel ───────────────────────────────────────
panel_merged4 <- panel_merged3 %>%
  left_join(wfh_industry %>% select(bea_code, wfh_index), by = "bea_code")

cat("\n=== FINAL PANEL ===\n")
cat("Rows:             ", nrow(panel_merged4), "\n")
cat("Industries:       ", n_distinct(panel_merged4$bea_code), "\n")
cat("Years:            ", min(panel_merged4$year), "–", max(panel_merged4$year), "\n")
cat("Missing wfh_index:", sum(is.na(panel_merged4$wfh_index)), "\n")

# Save final panel
write_csv(panel_merged4, "../Data/Intermediate data/panel_mergedfinal.csv")
cat("Saved → panel_mergedfinal.csv\n")

head(panel_merged4)
```

```{r}
cat("=== COLUMN NAMES ===\n")

         intelligence_index, wfh_index) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  print()

wfh_check <- panel_merged4 %>%
  group_by(bea_code) %>%
  summarise(n_unique_wfh = n_distinct(wfh_index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nIndustries with more than one WFH value (should be 0):",
    sum(wfh_check$n_unique_wfh > 1), "\n")
```
